WITH driver_qualifying_counts AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY driverId
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(CAST(qualifying_count AS REAL)) AS avg_count
  FROM driver_qualifying_counts
)
SELECT
  dgc.driverId,
  dgc.qualifying_count,
  CAST(dgc.qualifying_count AS REAL) / ac.avg_count AS ratio
FROM driver_qualifying_counts dgc
CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
